pages.title: Advanced Product Search for WooCommerce Management
pages.content:
One of WooCommerce’s limitations is that its standard tools don’t offer many advanced filters for finding specific groups of products to edit or export. For example, combining filters such as category, price range, and SKU prefix in a single search can be difficult. With [WP Sheet Editor](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/woocommerce-spreadsheet/), you can use almost any product field as a search filter, including custom fields and fields added by third-party plugins.

**Unlike storefront search bars designed for shoppers, this guide focuses on how store managers can use advanced product search filters in the WordPress admin dashboard to audit, bulk edit, and export WooCommerce items.**

You can download the plugin here:

[Download WooCommerce Products Spreadsheet Plugin](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=778&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=advanced-search-woocommerce-products#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/woocommerce-spreadsheet/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=advanced-search-woocommerce-products)
The **Search** tool in WP Sheet Editor gives you more control over how you find WooCommerce products. You can filter products by catalog taxonomies, product properties, variation data, and custom database fields, all from the spreadsheet interface.

## Opening the Advanced Product Search tool

To open the search tool in WP Sheet Editor:

1. Go to **WP Sheet Editor > Edit Products** in your WordPress dashboard to open the spreadsheet.
2. Click **Search** on the toolbar.

![Opening the Search tool from the WP Sheet Editor top toolbar in WooCommerce](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11143856/open-wp-sheet-editor-search-tool.png)

A modal window will open with the standard search options. You’ll also see an **Enable advanced filters** checkbox, which gives you access to more detailed search conditions.

![WP Sheet Editor standard search modal showing fields for keyword, categories, tags, shipping classes, and attributes](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11144352/wp-sheet-editor-search-tool-simple.png)

## Standard Catalog Fields

The main section of the WooCommerce **Search** tool covers the product information you’re most likely to use when searching your catalog.

### 1. Contains keyword

- **Target:** Searches product titles, short descriptions, and main content descriptions.
- **Matching behavior:** Matches both complete words and partial strings. For example, searching for 
```
hoodie
```

 can return products such as 
```
Blue Hoodie
```

, 
```
Men's Hoodies
```

, and 
```
Hoodie with Pocket
```

.

### 2. Taxonomies and Classifications

You can also narrow your search using different catalog classifications, including:

- **Categories:** Filter products by one or more categories. Selecting a parent category also includes products assigned to its subcategories.
- **Tags:** Find products using one or more catalog tags.
- **Brands:** Filter by native brands or taxonomies created by plugins such as WooCommerce Brands, Perfect Brands for WooCommerce, and YITH WooCommerce Brands.
- **Shipping Classes:** Find products assigned to specific shipping classes, such as 
```
Heavy Items
```

, 
```
Fragile
```

, or 
```
Bulky Freight
```

. This can be useful when checking whether products have the correct shipping rules.
- **Type:** Filter by WooCommerce product type, including Simple, Variable, External/Affiliate, and Grouped products, as well as custom types added by extensions.
- **Visibility:** Filter products according to their catalog visibility status.
- **POS Product Visibility:** Find products that are enabled, disabled, or published exclusively for POS registers.
- **Attributes:** Filter by global attributes configured under **Products > Attributes**, such as 
```
pa_color
```

 or 
```
pa_size
```

. You can also select specific terms, such as 
```
Red
```

 or 
```
Large
```

, to find products using those attribute values.

## Search on Variations

WooCommerce stores variable products as parent products, while their individual variations are saved separately as child records. The standard WordPress admin screens don’t provide a convenient way to search directly through this variation data.

The **Search on variations** checkbox lets you include variation records in your search:

- **When enabled:** WP Sheet Editor searches both parent products and child variations. If a variation matches your criteria, such as a variation SKU, price, or attribute term, the spreadsheet shows the parent product along with the matching variation.
- **When disabled:** The search only checks parent and simple products, leaving child variation data out of the search.

## Advanced product search

When you check **Enable advanced filters**, WP Sheet Editor opens a database query builder that gives you much more control over which products are included in the results.

![WP Sheet Editor advanced search builder showing field, operator, and value rows](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11153703/advanced-search-wp-sheet-editor.jpg)

Each rule consists of three parts:

- **Field:** Select the database column or meta key you want to search.
- **Operator:** Choose how the field should be compared with the value you enter.
- **Value:** Enter the text, number, or list of terms you want to match.

### Advanced search operators

| Operator | Description & Usage | Example Query |
| --- | --- | --- |
| = | Finds an exact match for a number, text string, or system key. | Regular Price (=) 49.99 |
| != | Excludes exact values from the results. | Category (!=) Men |
| < and <= | Finds numeric values that are less than, or less than or equal to, the specified value. | Stock (<=) 5 |
| > and >= | Finds numeric values that are greater than, or greater than or equal to, the specified value. | Total Sales (>) 100 |
| Any of these values | Matches any value in a list. Separate the values with semicolons (;). | SKU (Any of these values) SKU-01; SKU-02; SKU-03 |
| CONTAINS | Finds a specific string anywhere within a field. | Title (CONTAINS) Cotton |
| NOT CONTAINS | Excludes items containing a specific string. | Title (NOT CONTAINS) Sample |
| STARTS WITH | Finds fields that begin with a specific prefix. | SKU (STARTS WITH) 2026- |
| NOT STARTS WITH | Excludes fields that begin with a specific prefix. | SKU (NOT STARTS WITH) OLD- |
| ENDS WITH | Finds fields that end with a specific suffix. | SKU (ENDS WITH) -XL |
| CHARACTER LENGTH < | Finds fields with fewer characters than the specified length. This can be useful for finding short titles or SEO metadata. | Title (CHARACTER LENGTH <) 20 |
| CHARACTER LENGTH > | Finds fields with more characters than the specified length. This can help identify long descriptions or URLs. | Product Short Description (CHARACTER LENGTH >) 160 |
| REGEXP | Uses a regular expression to find specific patterns in a field. | SKU (REGEXP) ^[A-Z]{3}-[0-9]{4}$ |
| NOT REGEXP | Excludes records that match a regular expression pattern. | SKU (NOT REGEXP) ^[A-Z0-9]+$ |
| Word count > | Finds content fields with more words than the specified number. | Description (Word count >) 300 |
| Word count < | Finds content fields with fewer words than the specified number. This can help you find thin or incomplete product descriptions. | Description (Word count <) 50 |
| Contains duplicate values | Finds records that share the same value in a database column. | SKU (Contains duplicate values) |

### Other advanced search filters

- **Not contains keyword:** Exclude products containing a specific keyword in the title or content.
- **Find these IDs:** Pull a list of specific post IDs into the sheet.
- **Find these URLs:** Filter products by exact URLs or permalink slugs.
- **Date range:** Filter products published within a specific date range using the start and end date pickers.

### Combining Multiple Product Search Rules

You can combine multiple search parameters to narrow your results down to a specific segment of your catalog. WP Sheet Editor uses **AND** logic between conditions, so a product must meet every selected condition to appear in the spreadsheet.

- **Example 1:** A standard filter set to 
```
Product categories: T-Shirts
```

 combined with an advanced filter 
```
Stock = 0
```

 returns only out-of-stock T-shirts.
- **Example 2:** An advanced filter 
```
Manage stock (=) Yes
```

 combined with 
```
Backorders (=) No
```

 finds products that use inventory tracking and don’t allow backorders.

For example, suppose you want to find products that meet all of these conditions:

- **Keyword:** Sprite
- **Category:** Gear
- **Search on variations:** Yes
- **Status:** Published

![Configuring combined search parameters with keyword Sprite, category Gear, published status, and variations enabled](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11154127/combined-advanced-search.png)

The search then returns only the products and variations that match all of those conditions:

![Spreadsheet grid displaying WooCommerce products and variations matching the combined search criteria](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11154412/woocomerce-advanced-search-results.png)

## Save searches for one-click access

If you regularly use the same search criteria, you don’t need to configure the filters from scratch every time. WP Sheet Editor lets you [save your search criteria and run the same search again with one click](https://wpsheeteditor.com/how-to-save-personal-and-global-searches-in-wp-sheet-editor/).

![Saved searches popup in WP Sheet Editor for naming and storing recurring filter presets](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/11154655/save-searches.png)

For example, you could save searches for:

- Out-of-stock products
- Products running low on stock
- Products in a specific category
- Products missing SKUs
- Duplicate SKUs
- Products with empty short descriptions
- Products with a specific SKU prefix

Saved searches can include both standard filters and advanced search rules. For example, you can save a combination such as 
```
Category = T-Shirts
```

, 
```
Stock <= 5
```

, and 
```
Manage stock = Yes
```

, then reuse those same conditions whenever you need to check that group of products.

Once a search is saved, you can select it from the saved searches dropdown and run it immediately. This is especially useful for recurring catalog maintenance tasks when you regularly need to check the same products.

## Export search results

After filtering your products, you can open the **Export** tool and download the search results as a CSV or Excel file.

Read our guide on [how to bulk export WooCommerce products with custom fields](https://wpsheeteditor.com/export-woocommerce-products-csv-custom-fields/).

## Bulk edit search results

You can also bulk edit fields for all the products returned by your search.

We have dozens of guides covering [how to bulk update your WooCommerce products](https://wpsheeteditor.com/blog/?s=&vg_tax%5Bfeature%5D=27&vg_tax%5Bplugin%5D=17).

You can download the plugin here:

[Download WooCommerce Products Spreadsheet Plugin](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=778&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=advanced-search-woocommerce-products#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/woocommerce-spreadsheet/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=advanced-search-woocommerce-products)

### Do you need help?

		You can receive instant help in the live chat during business hours, or [you can contact us](https://wpsheeteditor.com/company/contact/) and we will help you via email.

pages.title: 4 Best AI Tools for WooCommerce Stores to Automate & Scale
pages.content:
Every WooCommerce store owner or manager has repetitive tasks that take up more time than they should. You might spend part of the day writing product descriptions, answering the same customer questions, and updating product tags or SEO fields. When your store has hundreds or thousands of products, those tasks can quickly add up.

AI tools can help with some of that work. The idea isn’t to hand your entire store over to artificial intelligence, but to use it where it can save you time. For example, you can use AI to update product content in bulk, answer common customer questions, create product recommendations, or prepare marketing assets.

You can also read about the [best LLMs](https://wpsheeteditor.com/best-llms-woocommerce-product-descriptions/) to generate WooCommerce product descriptions.

Here are some AI tools that can help with different parts of running a WooCommerce store:

## 1. WP Sheet Editor – AI (Best AI Tool for Bulk WooCommerce Content)

![WP Sheet Editor AI interface showing bulk catalog management for WooCommerce stores](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14204234/bulk-ai-for-woocommerce.jpg)

When you manage a large WooCommerce catalog, editing products one at a time can get tedious quickly. **WP Sheet Editor – AI** adds AI tools to WP Sheet Editor’s spreadsheet interface inside your WordPress dashboard. Instead of opening individual product pages, you can work with many products at once.

Get the extension here:

[Sign up to the WP Sheet Editor - AI Service](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=41738&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=ai-tools-woocommerce#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/ai/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=ai-tools-woocommerce)
You can connect AI providers such as OpenAI (ChatGPT), OpenRouter, Studio LM, Gemini, and local LLMs, then use them to work with your product data directly from the spreadsheet.

Some practical ways to use it include:

- **Write product descriptions:** Generate long or short descriptions for products that are missing them, using information such as product titles, categories, and attributes.
- **Rewrite existing product descriptions:** Refresh outdated or repetitive [descriptions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ocOfZ7QvI94) while keeping important product details intact.
- **Optimize product descriptions for SEO:** Improve existing copy so it is clearer and better aligned with your target keywords and product categories.
- **Improve existing SEO content:** Update [meta titles, meta descriptions](https://youtu.be/Vm8L3Wms5-M), excerpts, and image metadata for older products.
- **Create SEO meta titles:** Generate meta titles in bulk based on product information and your naming rules.
- **Generate product excerpts:** Create short descriptions with a consistent format for product listings.
- **Add product tags:** Use product information to help assign relevant taxonomy tags.
- **Fill custom fields:** Populate ACF (Advanced Custom Fields) and other meta fields with information such as key features or technical specifications.
- **Translate product information:** Translate titles, descriptions, and custom fields when preparing your catalog for different languages.

Instead of running a prompt separately for every product, the [Bulk AI API](https://wpsheeteditor.com/privacy-policy-bulk-ai-api/) lets you apply prompts to thousands of selected products in one batch. You can filter your catalog first, such as by selecting products that are missing descriptions or products from a specific category, and then run the prompt only on those products.

## 2. Tidio AI / Lyro (WooCommerce Customer Support)

Tidio’s **Lyro AI** connects to your WooCommerce product catalog and can use synced product information to answer questions and recommend products during customer chats.

- **WooCommerce product sync:** Connect your WooCommerce catalog to Lyro without coding.
- **Smart product recommendations:** Recommend products based on what shoppers ask about during a conversation.
- **Interactive follow-up questions:** Ask shoppers additional questions to better understand what they are looking for.
- **Visual product cards:** Show product information and previews directly in the chat.
- **Catalog management:** Resync your catalog, review products, or hide specific items from the AI agent.
- **Automated support:** Answer common customer questions using information from your synced store data.

![Lyro AI chat assistant integrated with a WooCommerce store catalog](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/15130014/lyro-ai.jpg)

## 3. AI Product Recommendations Pro (WooCommerce Upsells)

Managing upsells and cross-sells manually can become difficult as your catalog grows. [AI Product Recommendations Pro](https://www.saffiretech.com/woocommerce-product-recommendations-pro/) uses shopper behavior, cart contents, and order history to automate product recommendations.

Instead of creating and maintaining a large number of manual rules, the plugin can display personalized cross-sells, “frequently bought together” products, and offers at checkout. This can reduce the amount of manual work involved in managing product recommendations.

![AI Product Recommendations Pro plugin dashboard for WooCommerce](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/15130337/product-recomendations-pro.jpg)

## 4. Google Pomelli (WooCommerce Brand Marketing Assets – External Tool)

Keeping your branding consistent across your store, ads, and social media can take a lot of design work. **Google Pomelli** analyzes your website to identify elements such as your colors, fonts, logos, and overall visual style.

It can then use that information to create promotional banners, ad graphics, and other marketing assets that follow the same visual direction. This can be useful when you need new promotional materials without creating every design from scratch.

![Google Pomelli AI tool generating brand assets for online stores](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/15141048/google-pomelli-ai.jpg)

Adding AI to your WooCommerce store doesn’t mean you need to automate everything. It can be as simple as using AI for the repetitive tasks that take up your time. Whether you’re updating product descriptions in bulk, answering common customer questions, managing product recommendations, or creating product visuals, these tools can help reduce the amount of manual work involved. That leaves you with more time to focus on your products, your customers, and the day-to-day work of running your store.

pages.title: Best 2026 LLMs for WooCommerce Product Descriptions
pages.content:
Deciding on the best large language model (LLM) for writing WooCommerce product descriptions depends on what matters most to your store. You might prioritize natural-sounding copy, accurate use of product attributes, strict formatting, or API cost when generating descriptions for thousands of products. When you’re working with a large catalog, the goal is to find a good balance between writing quality, accuracy and cost.

Learn [How to Write WooCommerce Product Descriptions with AI](https://wpsheeteditor.com/ai-generate-woocommerce-product-descriptions/).

## Top LLMs for WooCommerce Product Descriptions

### 1. Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic)

[Sonnet 5](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-sonnet-5) is best known for generating natural and brand aligned product descriptions that don’t sound repetitive or overly promotional.

Its greatest strength may be that Claude follows writing style and tone instructions well, which makes it a good choice when you want natural product descriptions that are consistent with your brand.

Plus, it generally handles HTML formatting well, including unordered lists and bold text when these are specified in the prompt.

Although it works great with many types of products, its best use seems to be for apparel, lifestyle products, home decor and luxury goods where the tone of the description can have a direct impact on how the product is presented.

### 2. GPT-4o and GPT-4o Mini (OpenAI)

It’s been more than 2 years since [GPT-4o](https://openai.com/index/hello-gpt-4o/) was launched. But still in 2026 if you want an LLM that is great at following detailed instructions, handling structured content or generating product descriptions at scale, maybe you should use a legendary model like the GPT 4o models.

These models are really useful when your prompts include specific rules such as avoiding certain information, staying within a character limit or following a particular formatting structure.

GPT-4o Mini is a practical option for large catalogs because it has **low latency** and a **lower token cost** than larger models.

If your store has technical products, replacement parts, hardware, and need descriptions to follow strict length or formatting requirements, this can be your go-to.

### 3. Gemini 2.5 Flash (Google)

[Gemini 2.5 flash](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-2.5-flash) is great for processing large amounts of technical information and working with multilingual product catalogs. This LLM can process large amounts of unstructured information such as supplier tables or manufacturer documentation, and turn it into organized product content.

It can also be useful for translating product information and adapting product names and descriptions for different markets. Therefore it’s great for international WooCommerce stores, electronics retailers and catalogs with detailed manufacturer specifications.

### 4. DeepSeek v4 Flash

If your concern is generating product descriptions in large volumes while keeping API costs low, use [DeepSeek V4 Flash](https://www.deepseek.com/en/news/v4-preview/). It can handle standard product copywriting tasks at a low API cost, which makes it worth considering when you’re working with a large WooCommerce catalog.

DeepSeek v4 Flash is best fit for Dropshipping stores, large product imports, and wholesale catalogs where keeping generation costs down is a priority.

## How to use these LLMs to write descriptions

One of the biggest challenges when using AI to write product descriptions is moving the data back and forth between your WordPress site and external AI platforms. If you copy product information into ChatGPT or Claude, generate the description and then then paste it back into WooCommerce one product at a time, the process can quickly become tedious and error-prone.

[WP Sheet Editor – AI](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/ai/) brings AI assisted editing directly into your WordPress dashboard. In fact, we’ve put together a step-by-step guide where you can learn how to [generate product descriptions using any LLM](https://wpsheeteditor.com/ai-generate-woocommerce-product-descriptions/).

The plugin works with all WP Sheet Editor spreadsheets and can connect to providers such as:

- OpenAI (Text)
- OpenAI (Image)
- Nano Banana (Image)
- OpenRouter (Image)
- OpenRouter (Text)
- OpenRouter (Multimodal)
- Custom OpenAI-Compatible
- Custom OpenAI-Compatible Multimodal
- LM Studio
- LM Studio Multimodal

You can choose the provider and model that best matches your needs and budget.

Here’s a video where you can learn how to audit and rewrite/improve product descriptions with AI:

Get **WP Sheet Editor – AI** and start managing your WooCommerce catalog with generative AI.

### Do you need help?

		You can receive instant help in the live chat during business hours, or [you can contact us](https://wpsheeteditor.com/company/contact/) and we will help you via email.

pages.title: How to Edit WooCommerce Product Prices in Excel or Google Sheets
pages.category: Edit Woocommerce Product Prices Excel Google Sheets
pages.content:
If you need to**edit WooCommerce prices in Google Sheets or Excel**, you can export your catalog to a spreadsheet, make your changes there, and import the file back into WooCommerce. This is useful when you want to work with spreadsheet formulas, compare your prices with another file, or let someone else prepare pricing updates without giving them access to your WordPress dashboard. (If you prefer to edit prices directly inside WordPress using an in-browser spreadsheet, see our general guide on [how to bulk edit WooCommerce product prices](https://wpsheeteditor.com/woocommerce-bulk-edit-product-prices/)).

You can download the plugin here:

[Download WooCommerce Products Spreadsheet Plugin](https://wpsheeteditor.com/buy-extension/?extension_id=778&utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=edit-woocommerce-product-prices-excel-google-sheets#buy) - or - [Check the features](https://wpsheeteditor.com/extensions/woocommerce-spreadsheet/?utm_source=website&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=edit-woocommerce-product-prices-excel-google-sheets)

## 1. Export WooCommerce product prices to Excel or Google Sheets

The **Export** tool in **WP Sheet Editor** lets you download your product catalog as a CSV or XLSX file that you can open in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel.

**Optional:** Click **Display variations** if you also need to export and edit prices for product variations.

![Display WooCommerce product variations to export pricing to Excel or Google Sheets](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14091832/display-variations-to-export-pricing.png)

Go to **WP Sheet Editor > Edit products** and click **Export** in the top toolbar.

![Export WooCommerce prices with WP Sheet Editor](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084231/how-to-export-woocommerce-prices.png)

Configure your export settings:

- **What columns do you want to export:** Select the fields you need, such as 
```
Name
```

, 
```
SKU
```

, 
```
Regular price
```

, 
```
Sale price
```

, 
```
Date sale price starts
```

, and 
```
Date sale price ends
```

.
- **Which rows do you want to export:** Select **All the products from my current search**, or the products you have manually selected in the spreadsheet.
- **What app will you use to edit this file:** Choose **Microsoft Excel (XLSX)** or **Google Sheets (CSV file)**, depending on where you want to edit the file.
- **Name of this export:** Optional. Give the export a name if you want to reuse these settings for future pricing updates.
- Click **Start new export** to download the file.

![Set up export options to edit WooCommerce prices in Google Sheets or Excel](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084433/set-up-export-options-product-prices.png)

## 2. Edit prices in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel

Open the exported file in Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel and make your pricing changes. You can edit prices manually, use formulas to update multiple products at once, change sale dates, or compare your prices with information from another spreadsheet.

For example, if you want to increase prices by 15%, you can use a formula such as 
```
=C2*1.15
```

 and apply it to the products you want to update. You can also use formulas to add a fixed amount or calculate new prices based on values in other columns.

Using a spreadsheet also makes it easier to share pricing files with vendors, accountants, or assistants without giving them access to your WordPress dashboard.

![Bulk edit WooCommerce prices in Excel or Google Sheets spreadsheet](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084140/bulk-edit-prices-in-excel-or-google-sheets.png)

## 3. Import edited prices back into WooCommerce

When you finish editing the spreadsheet, save the file and open the **Import** tool in WP Sheet Editor. From there, you can upload the file and use it to update your WooCommerce products.

![Import product prices tool in WP Sheet Editor](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084249/import-product-prices-in-woocommerce.png)

Upload your file:

- **Source:** Select **File from my computer**.
- Click **Choose file** and select your updated CSV or XLSX file.
- Click **Next**.

![Select spreadsheet file to import WooCommerce product prices](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084412/select-csv-pricing-to-import.jpg)

**Optional:** Tick **Show advanced options** if you need to change CSV field separator.

![Advanced import settings for CSV product price updates](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084114/advanced-import-selection-settings.jpg)

Map your spreadsheet columns:

- Select **Import all the columns** to automatically match the headers, or choose **Select individual columns to import** if you only want to update specific price fields.

![Choose product price columns to map and import into WooCommerce](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084157/choose-columns-to-import-prices.png)

Next, choose how WP Sheet Editor should identify the products you want to update:

- Select **Update existing products and ignore new products** so the import only updates products that already exist in your store.
- **Matching Field:** Match the rows by **SKU** or **ID** so each update goes to the correct product.
- Click **Next**.

![Map rows by SKU to update existing WooCommerce product prices](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084328/map-rows-in-pricing-import-woocommerce.jpg)

Review the preview to make sure the products and prices look correct. When everything is ready, click **Start import** to apply the changes.

![Run the import to bulk update WooCommerce prices from Google Sheets or Excel](https://media.wpsheeteditor.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/14084349/run-import-woocommerce-prices.jpg)

## Start editing WooCommerce prices in Google Sheets or Excel

Exporting your WooCommerce catalog to Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets files gives you complete flexibility to manage product prices offline, run complex pricing formulas, and collaborate with your team safely. With **WP Sheet Editor**, you can export pricing columns in seconds, apply changes in your favorite spreadsheet editor, and import updated prices back to WooCommerce without risking catalog errors or granting full administrative access to offsite staff.

### Do you need help?

		You can receive instant help in the live chat during business hours, or [you can contact us](https://wpsheeteditor.com/company/contact/) and we will help you via email.

pages.title: How to Bulk Raise WooCommerce Product Prices by Fixed Amount
pages.content:
Increasing prices for WooCommerce products isn’t as easy as it seems. The native WooCommerce editor lets you do this, but there are some issues that large catalogs face. For example, you can only edit selected products, which is limited by the pagination size. Another issue is that WooCommerce isn’t a specialized bulk editor, so you can easily run into timeouts and server errors if you try to raise the prices of hundreds or thousands of products or variations.

That’s why, in this tutorial, we’ll show you how to increase prices by a fixed amount for hundreds or thousands of products. In the **Bulk Edit** tool, you need to select these values to increase prices in bulk:

## When you may need to increase prices by fixed number

- **Supplier price increase:** A supplier raises the cost of several products by $3. Instead of updating each product manually, you can add $3 to all of the affected WooCommerce prices at once.
- **Shipping cost increase:** If shipping costs go up, you may need to raise some product prices by $5 to cover the difference. With a spreadsheet, you can make that adjustment across hundreds of products in one go.
- **New handling fee:** If you introduce a $2 handling fee for certain products, you can add that amount to all matching products at once rather than editing them individually.
- **Premium category markup:** You decide to raise the prices of products in a premium category by $10. Filter the products by category and update them all at once.
- **Low-priced products:** You notice that some products under $20 have margins that are too low. You can add $3 to those products without affecting the rest of your catalog.
- **High-value products:** Products over $200 may require extra packaging or insurance. Adding a fixed $25 to their prices can help cover those additional costs.
- **Seasonal adjustment:** Fulfillment costs may increase during the holiday season. You can temporarily add $5 to selected products and update their prices in bulk.
- **Brand-specific increase:** If a particular brand raises its wholesale prices, filter your catalog by that brand and add $8 to all of its products at once.
- **Market adjustment:** Products sold in a specific market may have additional costs that you need to account for. You can filter those products and add a fixed number without changing prices elsewhere.
- **Minimum-margin correction:** After reviewing your catalog, you find that some products have margins that are too low. You can identify those products and add a fixed $4 to each price in bulk.
